facts.value: Discover new cultures and expand perspectives with a study abroad experience during your studies, whether through an internship or job in research.
Students can study abroad through an Erasmus program, improving language skills, learning about new cultures, and gaining valuable international experience for career success.
Options for teaching positions abroad are available at many partner universities of Goethe University.
Information regarding the search, organization, and funding for internships abroad, as well as important application deadlines, have been compiled.
Information for teaching students regarding internships abroad can be found at the Academy for Educational Research and Teacher Education (ABL).
Helpful information about executing the Erasmus program and coordinating departmental cooperations, along with snippets for web pages on international topics, can be found.
Administratively technical staff at Goethe University can find information regarding possible stays abroad.
